basics.name: Zhicheng (Stark) Guo
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher in Machine Learning and Interpretable AI
basics.summary: Machine learning researcher developing foundation models and interpretable AI for multimodal health data, including wearable physiological signals and medical imaging.

work.name: Duke University
work.summary: Developing foundation models and interpretable concepts for large-scale medical imaging, including mammography and lung cancer risk prediction.
highlights: Build large-scale data-processing, model-training, and evaluation pipelines for reproducible medical-AI research.
Evaluate the predictive and scientific utility of concepts extracted from foundation-model representations.

work.name: Texas Instruments, Kilby Labs
work.summary: Developed an LLM-agentic optimization framework for hardware-constrained neural architecture search and mixed-precision quantization on edge hardware.
highlights: Implemented multi-objective rewards and on-the-fly hardware profiling.
Developed specialized small reasoning language model groups using GRPO and fine-tuning for data-secure on-site inference.

work.name: Duke University Health System
work.summary: Investigated correlations between cellular populations and cognitive scores, developed machine learning models to predict drug use and impairment, and analyzed flow cytometry data.
highlights: Analyzed patient PBMC and CSF flow cytometry data.
Developed predictive models for drug effects using machine learning.
